test_title: PYST 18 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 19 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain coded language 'INDICT' is coded as 'YGLIRL' and 'NEATLY' is coded as 'DPWFIQ'. How will 'DIALOG' be coded in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5ea569aa8f23d7775edc159531ed25a3dda9c6720fdc4f377dff05c54a9e41f.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic: Each letter is shifted by **alternating positions** — first letter **+8**, second **+10**, third **+14**, fourth **−6**, fifth **−2**, sixth **+5** (fixed pattern based on positions).

Here, 

INDICT → YGLIRL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53b74c2b428d216cd8de446ed87fd10310a2cebe6fa95bd8a9ae1321c0ea9318.png] 

NEATLY → DPWFIQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0787b87bc1defae80dae24d5ca9d5d047d28bc32b208b7d42e7a15f218e1102f.png] 

Now apply the same positional pattern to **DIALOG**:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45c1c95fef112da9a6f0d2fa5e9125b84f60e88c9524332b1c5550ed20501f35.png] 

So, the code becomes **LSOFMG**

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**
